name: Pyrazolam
toxicity: potentially lethal when mixed with depressants like alcohol or opioids
summary: Research chemical benzodiazepine discovered by Hoffman-LaRoche in the 1970's. It has been reported to be sold on the research chemical market in the early 2010's. At lower doses it acts mainly as an anxiolytic compound, and at higher doses it has been reported to have sedating, hypnotic, amnesic effects while also lowering inhibitions. The drug is structurally similar to alprazolam, bromazepam, and triazolam. The drug is 12x as potent as diazepam.
advisory: Potentially lethal when mixed with depressants like alcohol or opioids.

pharmacology.text: Benzodiazepines produce a variety of effects by binding to the benzodiazepine receptor site and magnifying the efficiency and effects of the neurotransmitter gamma aminobutyric acid (GABA) by acting on its receptors. As this site is the most prolific inhibitory receptor set within the brain, its modulation results in the sedating (or calming effects) of pyrazolam on the nervous system.

uses.text: Pyrazolam (SH-I-04) is a benzodiazepine derivative originally developed by a team led by Leo Sternbach at Hoffman-La Roche in the 1970s. It has since been "rediscovered" and sold as a designer drug since 2012.

sideEffects.en: It has not been studied in clinical trials. Reported effects include drowsiness, memory loss and lowered inhibitions, and like other benzodiazepines it can lead to dependence, with dangerous withdrawal, including seizures, if stopped suddenly after heavy use.
sideEffects.zh: 它未經臨床試驗研究。已知效應包括嗜睡、失憶和抑制力降低，和其他苯二氮平一樣，它可能導致依賴，長期大量使用後突然停用可能出現危險的戒斷症狀，包括癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它未经临床试验研究。已知效应包括嗜睡、失忆和抑制力降低，和其他苯二氮平一样，它可能导致依赖，长期大量使用后突然停用可能出现危险的戒断症状，包括癫痫发作。

fact.en: In pyrazolam, the side benzene ring found in most benzodiazepines is replaced by a pyridine ring, which contains nitrogen, as in bromazepam.
fact.zh: 在 pyrazolam 中，多數苯二氮平上的側邊苯環被換成含氮的吡啶環，這點和溴西泮相同。
fact.zhHans: 在 pyrazolam 中，多数苯二氮平上的侧边苯环被换成含氮的吡啶环，这点和溴西泮相同。
